The App uses the upstream stdin pipe/socket EOF handling. The build applies scripts/patch-exiftool-heif.py to the extracted QuickTime module. It restores single-base TIFF-form EXIF offsets in ISO-BMFF containers. The original source archive is redistributed with its license. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
